text: Low: signed wake body has no expiry or nonce (ts is the message time), so a captured knock can be replayed; preview carries 200 chars of any member's text to a bridge that starts an agent run. isBlockedIp (line 252) misses NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 and 6to4 2002::/16. SSRF otherwise sound: literal check, pinned lookup, no redirects, own-target registration only.
